🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; independent confirmation comes from Financials and Industrials both negative, alongside all 11 sectors posting negative weekly returns. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5), but absolute breadth is weak; Style: no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads relatively: T (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY and VZ (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +2.83%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples follows with TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) and KHC (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities is third, though still negative for the week, with DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%) and SO (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest: sector returns were -13.10% for 1W and -18.76% for 1M; NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) and ORCL (1W: -19.27% | 1M: -19.40%) are BELOW TREND. Materials (-8.11% 1W) and Energy (-7.87% 1W) also lag; NEM (1W: -16.32% | 1M: -17.03%) and FCX (1W: -22.37% | 1M: -28.80%) are BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%) RECOVERY, TJX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -4.93%) RECOVERY, TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%) ABOVE TREND and T (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but the leaders’ weekly gains do not offset the market-wide decline.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
The supplied bottom performers include NEM (1W: -16.32% | 1M: -17.03%), UNH (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), CRM (1W: -17.09% | 1M: -27.84%), AMAT (1W: -18.20% | 1M: -19.30%) and LRCX (1W: -18.88% | 1M: -20.37%); all are BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Healthcare and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%) and TJX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -4.93%), both RECOVERY patterns; TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) remains ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is present: JNJ (1W: -5.35% | 1M: +1.07%), LLY (1W: -6.68% | 1M: +3.22%), HD (1W: -2.77% | 1M: +3.45%) and WMT (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +5.64%) are CORRECTION; watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Severe weakness: sector returns were -13.10% for 1W and -18.76% for 1M, with constituent breadth not supplied. AAPL (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -1.55%), MSFT (1W: -7.33% | 1M: -6.84%), NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) and GOOGL (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -18.18%) are all BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Broad pressure: sector returns were -7.55% for 1W and -5.60% for 1M; constituent breadth was not supplied. JPM (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -7.73%), V (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -2.83%) and MA (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -1.20%) are BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of -6.11% for 1W and -3.79% for 1M; constituent breadth was not supplied. UNH (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%) and PFE (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -8.61%) are BELOW TREND, while LLY (1W: -6.68% | 1M: +3.22%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor relative resilience over broad beta: TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), KHC (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%) and DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%) are ABOVE TREND, while Technology remains weak. Reduce exposure selectively to names showing persistent weakness, including NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) and CRM (1W: -17.09% | 1M: -27.84%), both BELOW TREND; style remains mixed, with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) and DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%), both ABOVE TREND, for continued relative resilience; PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%) needs follow-through after its RECOVERY move. BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) and INTU (1W: -20.85% | 1M: -23.80%), both BELOW TREND, for further downside or stabilization.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples and Communication are the relative leaders, but both remain negative on the week; overall breadth is 0/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Technology is weakest at -13.10% for 1W, followed by Materials at -8.11%; watch for stabilization before treating either as a turn.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not provided, so monitor percentage-based triggers instead: NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) for a pause in its BELOW TREND decline, and JPM (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -7.73%) for stabilization. TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) and DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%) are ABOVE TREND; watch whether their positive momentum persists.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+45): TD Cowen upgraded the stock; price is BELOW TREND at (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), diverging from the positive news. LLY (+40): Bank of America sees further upside; price is in CORRECTION at (1W: -6.68% | 1M: +3.22%), a short-term divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (-60): Revenue guidance cut; BELOW TREND at (1W: -20.85% | 1M: -23.80%), confirming the negative catalyst. NEM (-35): Gold-miner weakness cited; BELOW TREND at (1W: -16.32% | 1M: -17.03%), confirming pressure. AMD (-30): Short-seller report; BELOW TREND at (1W: -20.54% | 1M: -16.45%), confirming weakness; HD (-35): mortgage-rate concerns, with CORRECTION at (1W: -2.77% | 1M: +3.45%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with 0/11 sectors positive and no confirmed Growth-versus-Value style leadership. Relative strength is concentrated in TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) and DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%), both ABOVE TREND, while leadership across the Top 5 spans four sectors. Major divergences in JNJ (1W: -5.35% | 1M: +1.07%), LLY (1W: -6.68% | 1M: +3.22%), HD (1W: -2.77% | 1M: +3.45%) and WMT (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +5.64%) make this transitional at the stock level; wait for confirmation, with positive UNH news notably diverging from its price decline.
